text:
maria: Quick proposal 1: launch a small community pack: (A) three bite-sized tutorials (quickstart, deploy-local, and a pm-ops tip), (B) a compact benchmark narrative showing cost/latency tradeoffs across two model configs, and (C) a gated live webinar + office hours. We need owners and a shipping timeline.

lee_engineer: I'll take the bench writeup. plan: compare fp16 vs int8 quantized on 128/1024 contexts, P95 latency and tokens/sec, and a short cost-per-1k-token estimate. will output a CSV + a tiny matplotlib plot.

sam_devrel: I'll lead tutorials + refapp. idea: KISS examples 1) docker quickstart, 2) lightweight FastAPI inference sample, 3) notebook showing prompt engineering + eval snippet. aim to open repo PR by Wed.

olivia_pm: Landing + funnel here. We must tag leads with "community_pack" and "bench_webinar" in our CRM. Capture role (engineer/pm), org size, and main use-case. Route enterprise signals to AE queue.

maria: Good. Draft copy for top of landing: "Hands-on guide to predictable LLM inference: starter tutorials, real perf numbers, and a live walkthrough." Keep headings short.

ana_design: (ana_design) I'll mock 2 landing variants: hero with graph vs hero with demo GIF. prefer hero-with-graph for ops-oriented messaging.

lee_engineer: Note: include exact SLO-like numbers in the bench (e.g., "P95 = 120ms for fp16 @ 128 tokens"). Ops people care about numbers > adjectives.

sam_devrel: For the refapp I'll include a reproduce script: `./run_bench.sh --model fp16 --ctx 128` and a Dockerfile. Also will add a short GIF (30s) showing the refapp in action. PR link when ready.

maria: Timeline suggestion: drafts by Tue EOD, design mocks by Thu, landing up next Mon, webinar in 10 days. Can everyone meet that?

lee_engineer: Bench draft ready Tue. I'll attach CSV + PNG.

sam_devrel: Tutorials draft by Tue as well. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-pack-refapp/pull/7 (WIP)

olivia_pm: I'll create the HubSpot form and set routing. Example mapping I need from engineering (JSON payload) below:
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "company": "ExampleCorp",
  "role": "engineer",
  "lead_tags": ["community_pack","bench_webinar"]
}
```

maria: @lee_engineer can you add a tiny endpoint to post bench summary to the webhook so QA can exercise the funnel? staging auth okay (short token).

lee_engineer: Sure. I'll add a tiny serverless function + curl example: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer stg-token-123\" -X POST https://staging.redwood/hooks/lead -d '{"email":"qa@test","company":"QA Inc","role":"engineer","lead_tags":["community_pack"]}'`

sam_devrel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-pack-refapp/pull/7 1 includes quickstart, Dockerfile, example FastAPI, and notebook. README still needs a marketing TL;DR.

deploy-bot: deploy:community-pack-staging succeeded 1 logs: "community-pack v1.2 1 smoke tests passed" :white_check_mark:

maria: Nice. Next action list: 1) olivia finalize form + share URL, 2) lee add webhook + sample data, 3) ana share design mocks, 4) sam update README with a 2-line TL;DR for marketing. I'll draft 2 launch post headlines and share for quick edits.

olivia_pm: HubSpot form provisioned: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/98765/community-pack. I've set routing rules to send enterprise leads to sales.ae_queue. Will share live link once copy locked.

ana_design: Mock A (graph hero) pushed to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/community-pack-hero. Leaving notes about the graph callouts.

sam_devrel: README updated with marketing TL;DR + copy snippet for landing: "Try Redwood inference end-to-end: quickstarts, perf results, and a live walkthrough." Added GIF in /assets/demo.gif.

lee_engineer: Webhook + sample payload added under /tools/bench-webhook.md in the repo. Includes small HMAC signing example for staging.

maria: Great momentum. I'll schedule a 20-min copy/design sync tomorrow 10:00. After that we finalize landing and schedule webinar. Thanks team.

olivia_pm: Adding calendar invite now.

maria: thanks everyone, will ping once copy is in review.
